name: optryva
description: Optryva — AI job-matching platform, deployed as a single Cloudflare Worker (client static assets + /api).

scripts.build:client: npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.build: npm run build:api && npm run build:client
scripts.deploy:client: npm run build:client && wrangler pages deploy client/dist --project-name optryva
